responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation-URL companion for the Xtensa uClinux subtarget option table. It exists to associate any options declared in `uclinux.opt` with GCC manual anchors for help and diagnostic metadata; in this snapshot it is effectively empty because no URL mappings were generated, but it still serves as the per-subtarget placeholder that keeps the uClinux option-definition pipeline aligned with GCC’s option documentation machinery.
